correctness.rationale: At time one each leaf group is monochromatic because all leaves copy their core vertex. For any coherent state strict dominance of private leaves forces the core coordinate swap, making the closed state space exactly an involution. Counting yields 2^k fixed states and (4^k-2^k)/2 two-cycles. Conditional independence of pendant blocks given the initial core vector proves exact orbit probabilities. Two-phase averaging gives the expectation; the binomial-majority recurrence proves strict bias amplification whenever each core degree is nonzero. All 16,412 exact rational test comparisons passed.

value.rationale: A natural pendant-neighborhood dominance mechanism yields a complete all-size stochastic absorption distribution and expected long-run opinion effect; it is not merely a count of fixed states. The bounded-degree tree subfamily has exponential numbers of distinct recurrent orbit classes but enters one after one update, providing a meaningful contrast to large slow recurrent classes in published RMM work. The probability law permits exact distributional assessment for arbitrary core size and structure.
